what “i'll make sure it never happens again” actually means to me

when i'm frustrated → i'll communicate instead of taking it out on you.
when you do something for me → i'll appreciate it instead of making you feel like it's expected.
when i'm tired → i'll tell you i'm tired without making you feel like you are the reason.
when we fight → i'll remember that it's you and me against the problem, not me against you.
when i mess up → i'll listen instead of immediately trying to defend myself.
when you tell me something hurt you → i'll take it seriously, because your feelings aren't an inconvenience.

the part i really wanted you to read

come here my love

i don't want this website to be the thing that makes you forgive me. i don't want a bunch of pretty words, games, flowers, or little animations to cover up the fact that i hurt you. i know what i said mattered, and i know that when the person you love makes you feel unwanted or unappreciated, a simple sorry can't just erase that feeling.

i just want you to know that i heard you. i heard every part of what you said. i heard that you were hurt, that you were genuinely pissed at me, and that you don't want to feel like this again. and instead of getting defensive or trying to explain myself away, i want to actually take that feeling seriously because you matter to me way too much for me to treat your hurt like an inconvenience.

i love you. genuinely. not just when we're laughing and everything is easy, not just when you're being sweet to me, and not just when we're having one of those perfect days where everything feels right. i love you when you're annoyed with me. i love you when you're stubborn. i love you when you're emotional. i love you when you're angry enough to want to throw every single one of these little objects at me 😭. i love every version of you because you're still you, and you're still the girl i chose.

i'm not tired of choosing you. i'm not tired of loving you. i'm not tired of hearing you talk, i'm not tired of your messages, i'm not tired of your little habits, and i'm not tired of having you in my life. if anything, i want to become better at showing you just how much having you in my life actually means to me.

i don't want you to ever feel like you have to earn my love by being perfect. you don't have to constantly make me happy to deserve reassurance. you don't have to hide when something hurts you because you're scared i'll get annoyed. you don't have to wonder whether i'm going to stay just because we had a bad day. i want you to feel safe enough to tell me when i've hurt you, and i want to be mature enough to listen when you do.

and when we fight, i want to remember that it's you and me against the problem. not me against you. i don't want to win arguments if winning means making you feel smaller. i'd rather understand you, fix what i did, learn from it, and come back to you softer than i was before.

i know i can't promise that i'll never make another mistake. i'm human and sometimes i'll say something stupid or handle something badly. but i can promise that i'll care about the impact of my actions. i can promise that i'll listen. i can promise that i'll try to communicate instead of taking frustration out on you. i can promise that i'll appreciate the things you do instead of letting myself become so used to your love that i forget how special it is.

because you are special to me. you're my princess, my favourite person, the girl whose name can completely change my mood, the person i want beside me when life is exciting and when life is boring. i want the random conversations, the stupid jokes, the late nights, the little gifts, the flowers, the memories, the arguments we eventually laugh about, and all the ordinary days that don't look important until years later when we realize they were some of our favourite memories.

i want to keep growing with you. i want to become someone who makes you feel loved without you having to ask. someone who notices the little things. someone who knows when to listen. someone who can make you laugh after a bad day but also knows when you don't need a joke and just need to be held.

so if you're still mad at me after this, that's okay. you don't have to rush yourself into being fine. i'll take the anger, i'll take the complaints, i'll take the dramatic princess treatment 😭, and i'll still be here loving you. because i don't want your forgiveness just for the sake of ending an argument. i want to earn back the softness between us by showing you through my actions that i really understood what you were trying to tell me.

and more than anything, i want you to know this: i don't want a life without you. i want a life where we keep learning each other, keep growing, keep choosing each other, and keep finding our way back to each other after the difficult days.

i love you my princess. more than i can fit into this page, more than one apology can explain, and more than one bad night could ever change. 🤍

now come here. you've had enough time to be mad at me for five minutes. 🫂

🫂🫂🫂 i'm not letting go yet. stay here a little longer, pretty girl.
